steps.title: Define updated structures and configurations
steps.description: Configure app-meta.json and build-steps.json with upgraded sound, history, and theme features for Simple Calculator.

steps.title: Update build.gradle settings
steps.description: Ensure the build environment has correct versions (SDK 34) and standard Java 8 parameters.

steps.title: Refine AndroidManifest.xml configuration
steps.description: Maintain package configuration and standard attributes for the primary launcher activity.

steps.title: Redesign layout with premium modern UI
steps.description: Redesign activity_main.xml to incorporate a top tool bar (sound, theme, history toggles), an expandable scrollable history log panel, formula displays, and a beautifully structured responsive button grid.

steps.title: Initialize enhanced MainActivity features
steps.description: Add imports for SharedPreferences, Sound/Audio classes, and view animations, and declare properties for history, theme status, and tone generation.

steps.title: Implement dynamic ToneGenerator sound click system
steps.description: Integrate the built-in Android ToneGenerator class to play beautiful audio tones upon tapping keys, with an option to toggle audio feedback.

steps.title: Implement instant Theme Toggle engine
steps.description: Develop a dynamic runtime skinning function that updates colors of keys, texts, displays, and containers seamlessly between light and dark modes.

steps.title: Implement persistent SharedPreferences Calculation History
steps.description: Program functions to serialize and save calculations locally. Add UI binding to update, display, and purge the calculation history dynamically.

steps.title: Bind upgraded action elements and setup listeners
steps.description: Hook key listeners for toggles, backspace, mathematical modifiers, and digits using clean Java 8 compatible anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Building Simple Calculator
steps.description: Validate full system compiling via Gradle tasks ensuring functional integrity and no compilation errors.
